subject: Post-call: on-prem licensing, support band & environment count — next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: on-prem licensing, support band & environment count — next steps

Carlos — great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our call and asks so we can convert this into a term sheet and PO path: 

- Estimated token volumes: you described current & projected usage as roughly 1.0–1.8B tokens/month in baseline months with up to 3B tokens/month in peak campaign months. Please confirm if those ranges capture your internal forecast.
- Preferred deployment: private on-prem (air-gapped) with Redwood Private control plane connecting via customer-managed networking.
- Environments: you indicated 3 distinct environments (prod, pre-prod/staging, dev). Confirm if dev can be a shared small instance for cost savings.
- SLA & support: you requested a premium support band (24x7 escalation, 4-hour P1 response, dedicated TAM).
- Procurement timing: intent to commit H2 FY27; procurement will want a committed capacity + annual license/license+support contract and a separate implementation SOW for deployment.
- Budget guidance you shared on call: target spend range of $250k–$450k/year for licensing + support (this was directional). You also asked for a target $/1M tokens number — on our side we typically present unit economics in the term sheet once we agree on environment sizing and quantization profile; ballpark target options we can model: $350–$600 per 1M tokens depending on reserved capacity and quantization levels.

Next steps I propose: 
1) We (Redwood) produce a draft term sheet with two pricing bands (Committed Reserved + On-demand top-ups) and three support tiers, tied to environment counts and a token band for escalation pricing.
2) You confirm: (a) token forecast column for next 12 months (by month), (b) whether dev can be shared, (c) procurement contact + target PO date.
3) Internal handoff: Ben to sketch initial pricing bands; Lauren to scope implementation SOW.

I attached a short environment matrix template we used with other on-prem customers to help you fill item (a). If you can return the completed matrix by EOW (Jun 25) we can get a draft term sheet back to you the following week.

Thanks — call notes inline below for reference.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: env-deployment-matrix.xlsx (stub)

---
(On the call: Carlos Mendez (HealthBridge), Sara Lin (Data Eng, HealthBridge — left early), Aditya Rao, Ben Carter)

From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@healthbridge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: on-prem licensing, support band & environment count — next steps

Thanks Aditya — good summary and yes, that captures it well. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Token forecast: the ranges you list are consistent with our internal models; I can pull a month-by-month forecast but expect to land in the 1.2–2.4B average band given planned pilot growth.
- Environments: prod + staging are required to be isolated. We can accept shared dev for cost reasons but would like a small sandbox per team if feasible (we're OK if that is capacity-limited).
- Support: premium tier makes sense. We’ll need a named SLA for escalation to our Platform ops and a runbook for incident response.
- Budget: procurement is comfortable with the $250k–$450k range as a starting negotiation window; key requirement is that we can model committed discounted unit economics vs on-demand usage in the same contract.
- Procurement timeline: we start vendor review on Jul 5 and aim to have vendor selection and PO by Aug 15. Legal will request: SOC2 evidence, KMS details, and an encryption-at-rest attestation for the on-prem installer.

Actionable items we will deliver to you by Jun 25: a) month-by-month token forecast for 12 months, b) procurement contact (procurement@healthbridge.ai) and expected PO window, c) list of certification artifacts they need for legal.

Please include the term sheet with explicit $/1M token scenarios so procurement can see committed vs burst pricing.

—Carlos
Carlos Mendez
Head of Platform Engineering | HealthBridge
c.mendez@healthbridge.ai
+1 (617) 555-2442

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Post-call: on-prem licensing, support band & environment count — next steps

Aditya / Lauren — quick internal note with a proposed structure so we can turn the draft term sheet around fast: 

Pricing structure (proposal):
- Committed Reserved (base): annual license covering up to 1.2B tokens/month equivalent (tier A) — list price N, committed discount X%; target $/1M = $430
- Committed Reserved (expanded): annual license covering up to 2.5B tokens/month equivalent (tier B) — list price N2, committed discount Y%; target $/1M = $375
- On-demand bursts: billed at higher unit $/1M for consumption above committed amounts (target $/1M = $820)
- Quantization/Model profile adders: if they require FP16 or specific heavier models add a +10–20% on unit price

Support tiers: 
- Standard: business hours, 24-hour P1 response
- Premium: 24x7, 4-hour P1 response, named TAM, quarterly architecture reviews (recommended for HealthBridge)
- Enterprise+: Premium + on-site deploy assistance, SLA credits, dedicated engineering cadence

Environment pricing: base license includes 2 environments (prod + staging). Additional dev sandbox instances charged as small footprint environment credits (we propose 0.15x environment multiplier per sandbox).

I attached the term-sheet skeleton and the environment matrix template. Suggest Aditya propose Tier A and Tier B numbers to Carlos and present the delta in $/1M tokens so procurement can see clear economics.

Next steps for us: Ben to populate numbers and run unit econ model, Lauren to draft SOW outline for deploy services and estimate implementation timeline (~6–8 weeks).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: RWI-term-sheet-v2.pdf (stub), env-deployment-matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: on-prem licensing, support band & environment count — next steps

Carlos — thanks for the quick confirmation and procurement timeline. Attaching our draft term-sheet and environment matrix for you to review — the term sheet includes two committed bands (Tier A and Tier B) with explicit $/1M token examples and support tier language. 

Ask: can procurement confirm by Jun 30 whether they want the on-site implementation SOW included in the initial PO or as a separate SOW? That decision affects payment milestones. Also confirm whether dev sandboxes should be treated as shared credits vs named sandboxes (we model cost differently).

If procurement wants, I can set up a 30-minute call this week with Ben and Lauren to walk through the term sheet line-by-line before we send to Legal. What time windows work for you?

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
